milestones.purpose: Build a substantially more realistic 3D racing alpha without padding source volume; goal at least 200,000 qualifying production C++ lines before its pre-release, plus genuine play quality.
acceptance: Milestone UE5.8 playable evidence is validated; do not merge source-only drafts on CI results alone

Test real six-car physical AI, start grid, per-actor identity, fleet collision, recoveries, gameplay scoring and fail-closed launch

Publish only a guarded, accurately labeled pre-release; do not imply first stable v1.0.0 is complete

Administrative milestone guidance and read-only audit PR; its review must not gate the independent pinned v0.5.98 source release or real UE5.8 qualification.
